hierarchy.name: Cranial Skull
hierarchy.description: Bony structure protecting the brain, consisting of the neurocranium and facial skeleton.

children.name: Meningeal Layers
children.description: Three protective membranes: Dura Mater (outer thick layer), Arachnoid Mater (vascular web), and Pia Mater (adhered directly to gyri).

children.name: Frontal & Prefrontal Lobe
children.description: Responsible for high-level executive function, motor control, speech production, and personality.

subRegions.name: Dorsolateral Prefrontal Cortex (DLPFC)
subRegions.function: Executive control, working memory, task-switching, and emotional regulation.
subRegions.deficit: Dysexecutive syndrome, planning deficits, cognitive rigidity.

subRegions.name: Orbitofrontal Cortex (Phineas Gage Region)
subRegions.function: Impulse control, value-based decision making, social decorum, and reward regulation.
subRegions.deficit: Orbitofrontal disinhibition syndrome, profound personality alteration, risk-seeking behavior.
subRegions.dsm5: Behavioral Variant Frontotemporal Neurocognitive Disorder (F02.80), OCD (300.3)

subRegions.name: Broca's Area
subRegions.function: Motor speech articulation and syntactic language construction.
subRegions.deficit: Broca's Expressive Aphasia (halting, non-fluent speech with preserved comprehension).

children.name: Temporal Lobe
children.description: Processes auditory input, speech comprehension, visual object recognition, and memory formation.

subRegions.name: Wernicke's Area
subRegions.function: Semantic speech comprehension and phonological decoding.
subRegions.deficit: Wernicke's Receptive Aphasia (fluent 'word salad' speech with severe comprehension loss).

subRegions.name: Fusiform Face Area / Ventral Visual Stream
subRegions.function: High-level object, place, and facial feature recognition ('What' pathway).
subRegions.dsm5: Major Neurocognitive Disorder Due to Alzheimer's (Visuoperceptual Domain)
